uutiset.t: Former SEC Chair Gary Gensler Warns Anthropic’s Cash Flow Poses Big Risk To AI Economy
uutiset.s: Gary Gensler, former SEC Chair and Professor of the Practice of Global Economics and Management and Finance at MIT Sloan School of Management, joined Bloomberg’s Romaine Bostick about Anthropic and OpenAI’s corporate governance structure, the evolving role of the SEC, and risk factors he’s watching.

uutiset.t: Eddie Best on Expectations for Anthropic’s IPO
uutiset.s: Edward Best, co-chair of Wilkie Farr & Gallagher’s capital markets practice, discusses Bloomberg’s report that Anthropic may price its IPO at $83 per share, up from an initial marketing price of $70. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close". (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Brookfield-Backed Lotto Firm Logs Earnings Hit, Buys Back Bonds
uutiset.s: Earnings at Brookfield-backed lottery business Scientific Games Holdings LP fell in the last quarter, hurt by one-time costs related to delayed contract completions, according to people with knowledge of the matter.

uutiset.t: Citi CEO Looks Forward to Working With Sen. Warren
uutiset.s: Citigroup Inc. Chief Executive Officer Jane Fraser says she is ready to work with Senator Elizabeth Warren, a Democrat from Massachusetts, who has been critical of the bank. She speaks to Lisa Abramowicz at a Bloomberg Newsmakers event in Washington. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Challenger Rejects New $4.4 Billion Daiichi Life Takeover Bid
uutiset.s: Challenger Ltd. has rebuffed a revised A$6.5 billion ($4.4 billion) takeover offer from Daiichi Life Group Inc., marking the second rejection in a month for the Japanese insurer.

uutiset.t: Nasdaq Futures Rise After Anthropic IPO Pricing: Markets Wrap
uutiset.s: US equity-index futures rose in early Asian trading after Anthropic PBC was said to price its initial public offering above the marketed range, providing a new test of investor appetite following weeks of losses in technology stocks. Copper declined.

uutiset.t: Farm Group Says Ex-CEO Misused Funds for Vacation Home and Plane
uutiset.s: When Matt Carstens stepped down as chief executive officer of Landus, the board of Iowa’s largest farm cooperative expressed gratitude for his “forward-thinking” leadership.

uutiset.t: Bloomberg New Economy Forum Opening Welcome Remarks
uutiset.s: John Micklethwait, Editor-in-Chief, Bloomberg, delivers welcome remarks at the 2026 Bloomberg New Economy Forum in Delhi. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Foreign Holdings of US Treasuries Decline by Most Since March
uutiset.s: Foreign holdings of US Treasuries fell in September by the most in six months, led by decreases in the stockpiles of China and France.

uutiset.t: Bloomberg New Economy Forum Day One Opening Address
uutiset.s: Gina Raimondo, Former Secretary of Commerce, US, delivers afternoon program opening remarks at the 2026 Bloomberg New Economy Forum in Delhi. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Bloomberg New Economy Forum Day Three Opening Address
uutiset.s: Rishi Sunak, Former Prime Minister & Member of Parliament, UK, delivers welcome remarks at the 2026 Bloomberg New Economy Forum in Delhi. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.s: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Vonnie Quinn, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Canadian Stocks Sink to June Low as Metals, Oil Losses Mount
uutiset.s: The Canadian equity benchmark fell to the lowest level since June as a selloff in metals and energy names dragged the market lower this month.
